annotations.title: Look up a song’s key by title

description: Look up the key, tempo (BPM) and typical vocal range of a well-known song by its title, in Tera Studio's song list (key and tempo from AcousticBrainz's analyses of the recording). Returns the key with its relative key, how many analyses agree on it, the BPM when they agree, an estimated range, and links to the song's page and to the key changer. Use it when someone names a song and asks its key or tempo, or whether it suits their voice. Pass semitones if they want it higher or lower. A song outside the list comes back as not found, with the key finder and key changer for a file they have.

artist.description: Who sings it, if the person said; it picks between songs that share a title.

semitones.description: How far to move the song for their voice, from -6 to 6 semitones; negative is lower. Leave it out to keep the original key.

title.description: The song's title, without the artist.
